title: Puthoff and Green introduce owner to Bigelow

tellings.quote: I'm thankful that they trusted me, that they reached out to me with the opportunity to meet with Mr. Bigelow.

plain: Around 2016, two men named Hal Puthoff and Kit Green reached out to the man who now owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property where strange events are said to happen, and arranged for him to meet Robert Bigelow. The owner tells this himself, saying he is thankful they trusted him with the chance to meet "Mr. Bigelow." He tells it as the start of his own path into the ranch.
